title: observability-weekly-2026-09-14
body:
Observability team weekly notes — Week of 2026-09-14

Attendees: Lena, Marco, Priya, Diego, Sam (SRE), Mei (Platform eng)

TL;DR:
- Tracing: rolled out sampling-tuning v2 to us-east canary (10% of traffic) — preliminary reduction in ingest QPS by ~18% without noticeable loss in trace fidelity. Need to monitor waterfall completeness for long-tail requests.
- Dashboards: new cost-per-route dashboard merged to prod, initial feedback good but missing per-model breakdown for dedicated customers.
- Cost telemetry: first pass rollout of token-level cost attribution landed in dev; heavy validation ongoing.

Standup highlights / individual updates:
- Lena: deployed tracing sampling-tuning v2 to canary. Observed 18% QPS drop at ingestion pipeline, CPU down ~12% on trace-processor nodes. TODO: run the waterfall completeness eval (eval set: /confluence/obs/tracing/waterfall-eval) and compare spans/sec for p95 long-tail.
- Marco: dashboard PR (#231) merged; added cost-per-route and per-region heatmap. Still need per-model column — blocked waiting on model-id mapping from model-service (JIRA-OBS-742).
- Priya: cost telemetry plumbing complete for hosted-api; working on validation harness. Found mismatch between billing tokenizer and inference tokenizer for ~2% of requests causing attribution drift. Filing an investigation ticket.
- Diego: tracing retention policy proposal draft ready. Suggest 30d high-res, 90d sampled. Shared draft in slack for feedback.
- Sam (SRE): noticed two increased tail-latency incidents for trace ingestion last weekend (2026-09-12 02:30 UTC). Root cause: compaction job overlap. Mitigations: jitter compaction schedule + safety throttle.

Metrics snapshot (week-over-week):
- trace-ingest QPS (global): -12%
- avg spans/request: +3% (sampling tweak capturing more heads)
- trace-processor CPU: -12%
- dashboards load time (median): 420ms -> 380ms after CDN tweak
- cost-attribution accuracy (internal test set): 94% -> currently 92% (regression due to tokenizer mismatch)

Tracing: notes and next steps
- Canary results look promising. Action: run waterfall completeness eval on last 24h of canary traffic (Lena) — due 2026-09-16.
- Verify long-tail user journeys (sessions > 120s) maintain >90% span coverage. If <90% then rollback sampling change for those routes.
- Diego to finalize retention policy RFC by EOW (2026-09-18). Include cost estimates for storage and query latency impact.
- Investigate trace ingestion backpressure during compaction windows — Sam to add compaction telemetry and propose safe throttle limits.

Dashboards & Visualization
- Marco merged cost-per-route dashboard. Known gaps: per-model column blocked by model-service mapping. Priya to coordinate with model-service (owner: Arjun) on API for model-id->route mapping. Link: JIRA-OBS-742.
- UX feedback collected from support: need quick-filter by customer tier (hosted/dedicated/private). Add filter in next sprint.
- Dashboard perf: CDN tweak reduced median load time; still seeing p99 spikes when many widgets have live queries. Plan: implement query-caching layer for high-cardinality widgets (proposal in github PR #240).

Cost telemetry
- Token-level attribution: dev rollout complete; validation failing on tokenizer mismatch (~2% of attribution). Priya opened INVEST-187 (internal) to reconcile tokenization.
- Need synthetic workload to validate attribution under batching and streaming — Diego to produce dataset and run through the billing pipeline.
- Questions: do we keep attribution at sub-request granularity for streaming responses? Early cost shows streaming increases attribution complexity. Decision needed: snapshot-per-chunk vs final-message attribution. Put on agenda for design meeting.

Oncall / Incidents
- Incident 2026-09-12: trace ingestion tail-latency. Root cause: compaction overlap + IO contention on NFS backups. Postmortem draft in Confluence (CONFLUENCE-OBS-INC-20260912). Actions: add compaction jitter (done), throttle compaction under high-ingest (in progress), schedule backup windows off-peak.
- Pager rotations: Mei will take rotation 2026-09-17 to 2026-09-23. Reminder: update escalation policy doc if compaction throttle becomes permanent.

Meeting notes (2026-09-14 triage):
- Discussed sampling v2 threshold tuning. Consensus: keep canary at 10% and expand to 35% if waterfall eval passes.
- Agreed to prioritize model-id mapping for dashboards (blocker for customer-facing billing views).
- Decided to adopt snapshot-per-chunk attribution for streaming for MVP, with caveat to revisit after month of telemetry. Priya to document assumptions.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Lena: run waterfall completeness eval on canary -> 2026-09-16.
- Marco: add customer-tier filter to cost dashboard and follow up on per-model mapping -> 2026-09-22.
- Priya: investigate tokenizer mismatch and file INVEST-187 updates -> 2026-09-18.
- Diego: produce synthetic workload for cost attribution testing -> 2026-09-20.
- Sam: add compaction telemetry + propose throttle limits -> 2026-09-17.
- Mei: update oncall rotation calendar and escalation doc -> 2026-09-15.

Risks / Outstanding questions:
- If tokenizer mismatch is systemic, cost attribution accuracy could remain <95% and impact billing confidence. Need contingency: fallback to route-level coarse attribution for billing.
- Storage cost if we keep high-res traces for 30d needs budget sign-off — include numbers in retention RFC.
- Per-model breakdown latency: additional join to model-service may add 50-150ms to dashboard queries. Explore caching model-id map in telemetry service.

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Consider adding a lightweight span-summary vector (small fingerprint) to reduce ingest size but keep critical event markers. Prototype idea: small bloom+min-hash per trace.
- Could leverage dedicated GPU pools telemetry to attribute heavy requests to dedicated customers separately to reduce noise on hosted metrics.

Links / references:
- Waterfall eval harness: confluence://obs/waterfall-eval
- Dashboard PR: github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/231
- Tokenization mismatch ticket: INVEST-187
- Incident postmortem: CONFLUENCE-OBS-INC-20260912

Next meeting: 2026-09-21 10:00 PT — agenda: waterfall eval results, tokenizer investigation update, dashboard per-model plan.

-- Lena
